data.name: Description
data.value: Projects supported UBL/CII invoice fields into new local views and exports without changing or validating the original invoice.

data.name: EmbeddedDescription
data.value: Reads one supported embedded invoice XML from a local PDF without extracting attachment paths or validating PDF/A conformance.

data.name: Notice
data.value: Visualization/export of selected source fields only. This is not the original electronic invoice. XML parsing does not validate XRechnung, EN16931, PDF/A, signatures or business rules. Totals are copied without recalculation; omitted fields and attachments remain in the original. Preserve and check the original invoice.

data.name: Limits
data.value: Supports a bounded UBL Invoice/CreditNote and CII 100 subset with line items. XML: 5 MiB, depth 64, 100,000 elements and 10,000 lines; individual text: 32,767 characters. PDF containers: 25 MiB and 200 pages; exactly one named factur-x.xml, zugferd-invoice.xml or xrechnung.xml is required. Encrypted containers, ambiguous fields, mixed amount currencies and unsupported decimal precision are refused. CSV formula-like text is prefixed with an apostrophe; use XLSX for literal identifiers.

data.name: Preview
data.value: Supported invoice data can be projected locally. No invoice contents are displayed; no standards validation was performed.

data.name: Invalid
data.value: The invoice is malformed, ambiguous, unsupported or exceeds its limits, or local output rendering failed. Use supported UBL/CII XML with line items or one unencrypted supported embedded invoice. No conformance result is available.

data.name: ReadError
data.value: The invoice input could not be read.

data.name: CleanupError
data.value: Temporary browser data could not be removed. Check temporary-folder access and retry.

data.name: PrinterUnavailable
data.value: PDF visualization requires the local document printer and an installed Microsoft Edge browser.

data.name: ViewDescription
data.value: Creates a new self-contained HTML view of supported invoice parties, lines, taxes and source totals.

data.name: PdfDescription
data.value: Creates a new PDF visualization of supported invoice fields through the local contained document printer.

data.name: CsvDescription
data.value: Exports invoice line items with invoice identity and source totals into a new UTF-8 CSV file.

data.name: ExcelDescription
data.value: Exports supported invoice headers, lines, tax breakdown and payments into four new Excel worksheets.

data.name: ExtractDescription
data.value: Extracts one recognized embedded invoice XML as a new file, preserving its decoded bytes and the original PDF.
